data_generation_methods.evidence: Across LongEval, LV- Eval, and A100 prefill benchmarks on LLaMA, Qwen, and Vicuna, TileMix recovers longcontext quality lost under uniform INT8 and improves prefill throughput over FP16, yielding a controllable accuracy-efficiency frontier across model families.
